tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand. The v3 blue, kept from 2023. The page ground everywhere.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Brand. Text and the logo on blue (5.3:1).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Brand. Muted text on blue (4.6:1, just passes AA). Metadata only, never smaller than 14px.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Brand accent: the star, focus rings, primary buttons, sticky notes. One accent per view.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Brand. Deep navy: reading column, terminal objects, text on star and paper.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Desk objects: index cards, receipts, polaroids, clippings.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper (6.4:1) and on star (5.4:1).

tokens.name: blue-shade
tokens.usage: A step darker than blue: hover fills, muted bands. Ice on it is 6.2:1.

tokens.name: salmon
tokens.usage: Error text on blue (4.9:1). Form errors only; the site has almost no error states.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn --foreground. Body and heading text on background.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn --card. Deep surfaces: the case-study reading column, the contact panel.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn --primary. Primary button fill (one per view).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn --secondary. Outline button fill: the ground shows through, with a border token edge.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, dates (4.6:1 on blue, 5.3:1 on muted).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn --accent. Hover fill for ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only: not for control edges.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Control edges: outline buttons, inputs (5.3:1 on blue, meets 3:1 for non-text).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px, 3px offset, always over blue (5.1:1).

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and labels on paper objects.

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Terminal prompt and path (7.6:1 on deep).

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Notebook grid on blue (from direction B). Desk section only: no text under 24px may sit directly on it (mist over a line drops to 4.0:1).

tokens.name: grid-line-card
tokens.usage: Notebook grid on the deep reading column. Ice stays at 11.3:1 and mist at 9.8:1 over a line.

tokens.name: grid-line-card-major
tokens.usage: Every 4th line (grid-major) on the reading column. Ice 10.2:1 over it.

tokens.name: grid-line-paper
tokens.usage: Notebook grid on paper: notebook-page objects, the 404 page sheet. Ink 12.7:1 over it.

families.heading: "Syne Variable", Syne, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: bits and pieces on my desk

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Case-study subheads, project titles in lists. Fluid 20→26px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I've spent years building a toolbox, and I like putting it to work in unexpected ways.
styles.usage: All running text, max 65ch. Syne is never used for body (PORT-004).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: How millions of customers choose and manage card fees.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: The interaction log, printed as 3D prisms.
styles.usage: Figure captions. Smallest size allowed in muted-foreground.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: at momoGood · previously Itaú · são paulo
styles.usage: Hero meta line, dates, project metadata. Lower-case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: summary dt, receipt lines, object captions. Foreground or paper-foreground only, never muted at this size.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: fig. 2 · the prisms, printed from the interaction log
styles.usage: Margin notes on the reading column (from direction B), in muted-foreground. Starts with a figure label or a date in 2026.05 form.

spacing.note: Tailwind's default 4px scale (--spacing: 0.25rem): space-N is p-N, gap-N and so on.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and object padding (mobile). Minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Desk objects. Paper has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Deep surfaces: reading column, contact panel.

tokens.name: shadow-object-lift
tokens.usage: A desk object on hover or focus (lifted).

fluid.note: Linear clamp between 375px and 1440px viewports. Used for the font-size and padding of the styles named in each usage note.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tap target.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: Notebook grid square. Equals the column gutter (space-6), so the grid lines up with the 12-column layout.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Every 4th grid line is stronger (on the reading column only).

tokens.name: margin-width
tokens.usage: Margin-note column beside the reading column (desktop, ≥ lg). Below lg, notes sit inline after their paragraph.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Tailwind md. The nav switches from Menu button to inline links.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Tailwind lg. 12-column grid and the scattered desk.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Section entrance (from a visible resting state).

tokens.name: duration-star
tokens.usage: One full rotation of the hero star. Stops under reduced motion.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for everything that enters or lifts.

tilt.note: Desk-object rotation. Positions and tilts are set per object and breakpoint, never random.

tokens.name: tilt-2
tokens.usage: Default object tilt; the mobile maximum.

tokens.name: tilt-max
tokens.usage: Upper limit, so text stays readable.

tokens.name: z-object-focus
tokens.usage: A focused or hovered desk object comes to the top of the pile.
